title: Give new ideas when asked
rule: When asked for new ideas, do not recycle the same three.
example: After suggesting a heist, a reunion, and a trial, suggest an expedition when asked for another idea.
counterexample: Repeat the heist, reunion, and trial as the only choices.
rationale: A request for new ideas needs additional possibilities.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/models/xai/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
